title: Business English Conversation 33:  A Lunch Meeting
content: 1. to have time for lunch: to have free time to eat lunch - Do you have time for lunch now? - We have time for lunch every day from 12 to 1. 2. a lunch meeting: a meeting that takes place while eating lunch - Lunch meetings are casual and productive. - I think that lunch meetings are great for brainstorming and planning. 3. a raise: an increase in salary or wage - I got a raise last year. - I haven't gotten a raise in 3 years.
